stories.title: Valley Street closed while crews respond to brush fire in Portland
stories.summary: A brush fire near the Valley Street Dog Park in Portland has resulted in the street being closed while crews respond.

stories.title: South Portland to reopen city buildings after cybersecurity attack, investigation ongoing
stories.summary: South Portland will reopen all municipal buildings on Monday, though some systems remain offline.

stories.title: Woodstock woods fire burns 5.8 acres near popular hiking area
stories.summary: The Maine Forest Service said a downed power line caused the fire, which no longer threatens the public.

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Rain on the way tonight, big cooldown for Thanksgiving week

stories.title: Houlton police chief placed on paid leave
stories.summary: Houlton Police Chief Tim DeLuca is on paid administrative leave while the department investigates an unspecified matter. A captain is serving as interim chief.

stories.title: Maine man accused of terrorizing, threatening to burn down home
stories.summary: A 44-year-old man faces several charges after allegedly trying to break into a Hudson home, threatening to burn it down, and damaging a sheriff's cruiser.

stories.title: Bangor nonprofits make a push to feed families before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Local nonprofits, pantries, and police are working to make sure families and their furry friends do not go hungry this holiday season.

stories.title: Firefighters battle house fire in South Berwick Saturday afternoon
stories.summary: Crews from New Hampshire were called to assist as firefighters worked to bring the blaze under control Saturday afternoon.

stories.title: Federal judge orders release of man detained by ICE in Maine
stories.summary: A federal judge ruled that immigration officials unlawfully detained an Ecuadorian man in Maine, ordering his release and placing limits on his future detention.

stories.title: Brunswick dog gets second chance after euthanasia appointment canceled
stories.summary: A 3-year-old dog in Brunswick may avoid euthanasia after a sanctuary stepped in to find him a new home.

stories.title: Maine wrongful death lawsuit moves forward after gun parts seller settles
stories.summary: A Maine family's wrongful death lawsuit against an online ammunition retailer is moving forward after a second company named in the case reached a settlement.

stories.title: Crews battle forest fire in Woodstock, now mostly contained
stories.summary: CMP's outage map showed 37 people without power in the area of Mann Road, near Bucks Ridge, a hiking area, and North Pond.
